bayts.text: I say – and today I am full of shame for the multitude of sin, of calamities and of fear –:
O Lord, pour a blessing that may make me whole, with peace, upon him who is master among the messengers,
upon the Family and the Companions; and through him make me for ever sound of body and of heart, never swerving from You.
Harm has touched me (Qurʾān 21:83), O You besides Whom I have no one to turn to; and my harm is too great for my devices.
Harm has touched me grievously, O Gentle One (Al-Laṭīf) toward us: heal me, by the Messenger of Allah, of my ailments.
Harm has touched me, O Lord and O my King, O best of those who show mercy to the hard-pressed, swiftly.
Harm has touched me, but I do not turn to any healer but You, for a disease that has kept me from my work.
I have sought access, through the Chosen One, our master, to You, O Benign (Al-Barr), O Possessor of generosity and gifts.
Heal me then, by the Messenger of Allah, O my King, after the blessing with a peace without term.
And grant me today to be for ever one who follows in his footsteps in word, deed and character, until the end (of life).
Grant me the healing after which there is no sickness, and fulfil my hope in You and in the best of creation.
You are the One Who answers the hard-pressed when he calls on You (Qurʾān 27:62): so answer me, by the son of ʿAbd Allāh, father-in-law of ʿAlī.
You are the One Who answers the hard-pressed when he calls on You: so answer me, by the son of ʿAbd Allāh, of harmonious beauty.
Answer me then by the son of ʿAbd Allāh, our master, and grant him blessings from You on my behalf.
And make Your supreme worship and his service my habit, without any blight leading to (inner) corruption.
Wash away all my faults, heal my sickness, and make, Lord, the night vigil (tahajjud) one of my occupations.
And let my masters and (my) litanies be with me for ever, until the Gardens, and lead me along the best of paths.
Pour, Lord, a blessing that leaves no sickness in me, upon the Chosen One, and through him forgive my slips.
Pour, Lord, a blessing with peace upon the best of creation, and heal me of all ailments.
